_readme: Search questions for the postmortem index, each with the ONE postmortem that should come back.
Most are worded differently from the postmortem's title on purpose, so we test meaning, not copied words.
service: the app filter the AI would add, or null for none.
Two questions are 'near misses' (OTP problems that are NOT the QuickSMS outage, payments problems that are NOT the pool), to check the search picks the right one of two similar reports.
